method: For each finding, the System Public Graph's variables, statistic, interval and study population were compared by reading the paper's PubMed abstract (NCBI E-utilities) and, where Europe PMC served open-access full text, the full text. Statuses reflect only text fetched in this run; no background knowledge of the papers was used.
checkedBy: AI-assisted spot-check (Claude subagent); not reviewed by a human
scope: Pass 1: all 11 K540E-haplotype findings, then every sp_outcome finding tagged Nigeria (9), Kenya (23) and The Gambia (5): 48 findings from 25 papers. Pass 2: every remaining sp_outcome or k540e_haplotype finding with a graph_record country, in country order TZA, GHA, BFA, MWI, MOZ, UGA, COD, SLE, CMR, MLI, SEN, BEN, ZMB, SDN, ETH, then the rest: 102 findings from 45 papers. Together 150 findings, every country-naming finding the app shows. Most were checked against the PubMed abstract only; Europe PMC open-access full text was used where available. The Graph p value on l5J-ceSD7x could not be found in the accessible text and remains unchecked. Pass 3: the three not-country-specific haplotype findings shown on the Alert tab (o23pQ-icgn, gD0V6goixf, 489sn1mPQa; kind other_dhps), checked against abstracts only; neither paper had open-access full text, so whether their quintuple/sextuple definitions include dhps K540E is unverified. Total 153 findings.
